primary_decision: PRESERVATION_ASSERTED iff macro lower 95% percentile-CI bound > -0.005 (strict).
primary_gating_statistic: lower 95% CI bound of the macro-domain estimand
p_value_role: secondary / descriptive only for the primary preservation claim
per_domain_rule: A domain is reported as HARM if its own 95% CI upper bound is below 0; preservation cannot be claimed while any domain CI indicates harm.
